scope: Tool-neutral prospective adjudication of process termination and public report authority
precedence: timeout and forced termination remain terminal process failures
signals and execution infrastructure failures remain genuine crashes
normally exited processes are adjudicated against the current retained report
a complete internally error-free adapter-valid findings report is authoritative despite a nonzero normal exit code
invariants: a nonzero code alone cannot establish a crash when an authoritative findings report exists
an empty report after a nonzero exit does not erase process failure
missing malformed incomplete internally errored and adapter-invalid outputs remain distinct failures
status adjudication never receives fixtures expectations taxonomy labels or scanner identity
every report and process code remains retained as provenance

statuses.clean_successful_report: Normal exit code zero with a complete internally error-free adapter-valid report containing no findings
statuses.genuine_crash: Signal execution infrastructure failure or nonzero normal exit without an authoritative findings report
statuses.internally_errored_report: Schema-valid report that is incomplete or declares scanner-internal errors
statuses.malformed_report: Missing contract structure unsupported schema privacy-unsafe content or adapter-invalid output
statuses.missing_report: No current report artifact was produced
statuses.policy_exit_with_valid_findings_report: Nonzero normal exit with a complete internally error-free adapter-valid report containing findings
statuses.successful_findings_report: Normal exit code zero with a complete internally error-free adapter-valid report containing findings
